candidatePeople.note: 鎮惡 receives the surrender at Qiqiu and is the 王鎮惡 named in s0080.
陛下 addresses Hong, the sovereign Yi Heng is speaking to; Majesty is part of the address Your Majesty.
殿下 is the person being remonstrated with, Yao Yi (懿), the emperor’s younger brother.

candidateDispositions.note: 遠 occurs within 鎮遠, the military designation preceding Yao Wan. Distant Lands is a translated fragment of that designation.
散關 is the pass to which Yang Juan fled.
自汴入河 describes Shen Linzi’s movement from the Bian into the Yellow River.
Hearing is the verb 聞, with Yao Shao as its subject.
王師 and 晉師 identify the advancing army by the state of Jin.
越騎 is part of Yan Sheng’s command title 越騎校尉.
吳 is the regional designation in 吳寇, rendered ‘invaders from Wu’; the force belongs to Jin.
柏穀塢 is the stockade Zhao Xuan was sent to defend.
晉將 indicates Mao Dezu’s allegiance to Jin.
河北 locates the grain recipients north of the Yellow River.
和戎諸羌 means the several Qiang groups of Herong.
吳 in 吳寇 labels the invading Jin force by its southern region of origin.
撫軍 is Zan’s generalship. Pacifying is a fragment of its English rendering.
